boundaries: The four major CERN detectors are not four identical toroidal magnets. ATLAS employs toroids; the other major detector magnet configurations differ.
The four collision points are physically different locations, not four detectors watching the same collision event.
CERN confirms independent cross-checks, especially among general-purpose detectors; it does not implement OASIS quorum/emergence rules.
Mapping four witnesses onto a symbolic ring is an engineering analogy, not proof that four toroids physically generate matter or emergence.
The 240-microtick LCM grid is a mathematical software construction, not the LHC's revolution timing.
